info.title: OMS New Object Service
info.description: Provides operations for creating IBM i objects, object details such as source members and message entries, IFS stream files, and data areas in TD/OMS. The service also resolves target object, source, and IFS locations before creation. Created resources are associated with the specified task, but the required request fields vary by resource type.

servers.description: Base URL template for the TD/OMS New Object Service.

host.description: Host name of the TD/OMS server.

library.description: IBM i library containing the TD/OMS service program.

protocol.description: Transport protocol used to access the service.

port.description: TCP port on which the TD/OMS service is listening.

/add.description: Creates an IBM i object or an object detail, such as a source member or message entry, and associates it with the specified task. The required request fields depend on the requested object type and whether the request creates a full object or only a detail within an existing object.

post.description: Creates an IBM i object or object detail in the requested application, environment, and task. Use this operation for full objects such as programs and physical files, and also for detail-style entries such as source members and message entries. Depending on the object type, the request can require detail fields, source fields, template information, or a combination of these values.

requestBody.description: Object creation details, including the target, task, and optional source template.

200.description: The object was created and associated with the specified task.

400.description: The request is invalid or cannot be processed because of a client or business-rule error.

401.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, or expired.

/location.description: Returns the target object library and source library for the requested application, environment, task, object type, and attribute. For IFS routes, the response can also include the target directory.

post.description: Determines the target object library and source library for an object before creation. For requests using an IFS route, the response can include the corresponding IFS directory.

requestBody.description: Application, environment, task, and object characteristics used to resolve target locations before a create request is submitted.

200.description: The target object and source locations were resolved.

400.description: The request is invalid or the target locations cannot be resolved because of a client or business-rule error.

401.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, or expired.

/addIFSObject.description: Creates an IFS stream file and associates it with the specified TD/OMS task. The target directory is resolved from the application, environment, and route. An optional template file can be copied into the new file.

post.description: Creates an IFS stream file at the location determined by the application, environment, route, and optional subdirectory. Use this operation instead of `/add` for IFS resources. If a template file is supplied, its contents are used to create the new file; otherwise TD/OMS creates an empty stream file.

requestBody.description: Parameters for creating an IFS stream file, including the resolved route target, optional subdirectory, and optional template file.

addIFSObject.summary: Create an IFS file without a template

addIFSObjectUsingSubDir.summary: Create an IFS file in a subdirectory

addIFSObjectUsingTemplate.summary: Create an IFS file from a template

200.description: The IFS file was created and associated with the specified task.

/addDataArea.description: Creates an IBM i data area in the specified library and associates it with the specified TD/OMS task.

post.description: Creates an IBM i data area using the supplied type, length, decimal positions, initial value, and description. Use `/location` first when the target library must be derived from the application, environment, and task.

requestBody.description: Parameters for creating a data area and associating it with a TD/OMS task. The requested value type determines how `length`, `decimalPosition`, and `initialValue` are interpreted.

200.description: The data area was created and associated with the specified task.

addDataAreaResponse200.summary: Response to a successful API call.

400.description: The request is invalid or cannot be processed because of a client or business-rule error.

401.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, or expired.

applicationCode.description: Application code in which the new object is created.

task.description: Task associated with the new object. Every created resource is connected to this task.

environmentCode.description: Environment in which the new object is created. Use the environment that matches the resolved target libraries or route.

copyObject.description: Indicates whether source is copied from the related template: `0` disables copying and `1` enables it. This only has meaning when a compatible template is supplied.

newObjectTemplate.description: Name of the TD/OMS template used to define the new object. This is commonly used when the request creates a detail-style resource such as a source member.

newObject.description: Name of the object to create or, for detail-style requests, the parent object that receives the new detail.

newObjectLibrary.description: IBM i library in which to create the object or in which the parent object resides. This is commonly obtained from `/location`.

newObjectType.description: IBM i object type to create. For detail-style requests, this is the type of the parent object receiving the new detail.

newDetail.description: Name of the object detail to create, when applicable. This is typically required when the request creates a detail within an existing object, such as a source member or a message entry in a message file.

newDescription.description: Text description assigned to the created resource. For some detail-style requests, TD/OMS can store this text as the detail text instead of an object description.

newAttribute.description: Attribute assigned to the created object. Whether this value is required depends on the object type. For detail-style requests, this value can describe the parent object rather than the detail itself.

newSourceFile.description: Source physical file in which to create or locate the source member, when source-based creation is used. For object types backed by source, this can be required even when only a detail is being created.

newSourceLibrary.description: IBM i library containing the source physical file, when source-based creation is used.

newSourceMember.description: Name of the source member or source-backed detail to create. Depending on object type, TD/OMS can require this value even when the created detail is also identified by `newDetail`.

newSourceAttribute.description: Attribute assigned to the source member when source-based creation is used. This can be required for member-style requests even if the parent object attribute is also supplied elsewhere in the request.

temporaryOrVirtualObject.description: Indicates whether the object is virtual: `0` creates a regular object and `1` creates a virtual object.

addRequest.description: Request parameters for creating an IBM i object or object detail and associating it with a task. Required fields are conditional: standard objects generally use object, library, type, and attribute values; source-based objects can also require source file, source member, and source attribute values; detail-style requests can require `newDetail`, `newSourceMember`, `newObjectTemplate`, or other fields depending on the target object type.

status.description: Operation status. `*NORM` indicates success and `*TERM` indicates failure; consult `message` for details.

response.description: Result returned by an object-creation operation.

messageData.description: Substitution data associated with the message.

messageText.description: Human-readable text describing the message. Success responses can contain business-level details about the created object or detail, while failure responses explain why the request was rejected.

templateObject.description: Name of the IBM i object used as the source template.

templateObjectLibrary.description: IBM i library containing the template object.

templateObjectType.description: IBM i object type of the template object.

templateObjectDetail.description: Name of the template object detail or source member, when applicable.

template.description: Identifies the IBM i object and, when applicable, source member to use as a template.

applicationCode.description: Application in which the object will be created.

environmentCode.description: Environment in which the object will be created.

task.description: Task associated with the object being created.

objectType.description: IBM i object type whose target location is being resolved. This value determines which object and source defaults TD/OMS attempts to resolve.

objectAttribute.description: Attribute of the object whose target location is being resolved. For non-IFS requests this value is commonly needed to determine the target object and source libraries.

routeCode.description: TD/OMS route used to resolve the target location. This is mainly used for IFS requests and can resolve an IFS directory instead of object and source libraries.

locationRequest.description: Request parameters used to resolve the target object library, source library, and applicable IFS directory. This operation helps determine location values before calling a create operation, but it does not determine every conditional field needed by `/add`.

status.description: Location-resolution status. If the status is `*TERM`, the object and source libraries are not returned.

objectLibrary.description: Name of the target object library.

sourceLibrary.description: Name of the target source library.

directory.description: Absolute path of the target directory in the Integrated File System (IFS), when the route resolves to an IFS location.

locationResponse.description: Resolved target locations and any associated status message.

application.description: Application associated with the new IFS file.

taskNumber.description: Task associated with the new IFS file.

environment.description: Environment in which the IFS file will be created.

routeCode.description: TD/OMS route used to resolve the IFS file location. This is the primary location control for IFS creation requests.

ifsFileName.description: Name of the IFS stream file to create.

subDirectory.description: Optional path below the route's target directory in which to create the file. Supply an empty string to create the file directly in the resolved route directory.

subEnvironmentSequence.description: Sequence number identifying the sub-environment. Use `0` when no sub-environment is involved.

templateDirectory.description: Specifies the directory containing the template file to copy from. If left empty, the system will search for the template file first within the same route, and if not found there, anywhere else.

templateFile.description: Specifies the template file to copy when creating the new IFS object. If left empty, no template is used and a new, empty file is created instead.

addIFSObjectRequest.description: Request parameters for creating an IFS stream file and optionally copying its contents from a template. Route information determines the base directory; subdirectory and template values further refine creation behavior.

applicationCode.description: Application associated with the data area.

environment.description: Environment associated with the data area.

taskNumber.description: Task associated with the data area.

dataArea.description: Name of the data area to create.

library.description: IBM i library in which to create the data area. This is commonly resolved by `/location` before the create request is submitted.

type.description: Data area value type: character, decimal, or logical (1 or 0). This choice affects valid combinations of `length`, `decimalPosition`, and `initialValue`.

length.description: Length of the data area value. For character and decimal data areas, supply the exact storage length required by the data definition.

decimalPosition.description: Number of decimal positions for a decimal data area. Use `0` for character and logical data areas.

initialValue.description: Initial value assigned to the data area when it is created. The provided value must be compatible with the selected data area type, length, and decimal positions.

description.description: Text description for the data area, up to 50 characters.

addDataAreaRequest.description: Request parameters for creating a data area and associating it with a task. Unlike `/add`, this operation uses a dedicated structure because the data definition is driven by the value type and sizing fields rather than by object/source metadata.

addObject.summary: Create an object from a template
addObject.description: The template object supplies the source copied to the new object.

newMember.summary: Create a source member without a template
newMember.description: Creates an empty source member and associates it with the specified task. Member-style requests can require both detail and source-member fields.

messageDetail.summary: Create a message entry in a message file
messageDetail.description: Creates a new message entry as a detail within an existing message file object and associates it with the specified task.

message.messageText: Unauthorized or expired token. Please login again.

JWT.description: Bearer token used to authenticate requests. The token must be a valid JWT.
